name: 功能建议 / Feature request

title: "[Feature] "
---

## Use case and problem / 使用场景与问题

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way? / 你正在完成什么任务，当前遇到什么阻碍？

## Desired behavior / 期望行为

How should the feature work, and what result do you expect? / 希望如何操作，得到什么结果？

## Alternatives and devices / 替代方式与设备

Current workaround, relevant phones/cards and acceptable limitations. / 目前的解决方式、相关手机或采集卡，以及可接受的限制。
